method: Arithmetic channel means of explicit JPEG patches in the actual published desktop front stand and the 1965 source, no image alteration. Tree shadows and sky light remain in the app; lighter patches are not a calibrated sunlit swatch. The 1965 print is blue-cast and shaded. Ratios document the comparison and its limits, not an exact match or quarry identification.

neutral_light_reading_T2566.method: A neutral-light swatch: the mean linear colour of each K02 base-colour texture as baked into assets/web/keith_house_1808_prairie__as_built_1886.glb, times the load tint, with no sky, sun, shade or tone mapping. Ratios are of linear albedo. The 1965 patch is the only colour evidence; it is shaded and blue-cast, so its b/g says little about the stone, while its r/g near 1.0 rules out a green cast (sky shade raises blue, it does not lower red against green).
neutral_light_reading_T2566.reading: Before, the granite read green-grey under neutral light (r/g 0.898). Both stones are now neutral grey at the same green-channel lightness. This is a reconstruction consistent with the one colour print, not a measured quarry colour; the tier stays reconstructed under L-k01-keith-finish-1883.

T2769_1965_neutrals.method: Arithmetic sRGB means of rectangular patches in the 1965 slide (no image alteration), converted to linear light and CIELAB (D65). Each candidate neutral is used in turn as a white-balance reference (per-channel linear gains to its own mean), and the lit stone patches are read through it. A patch is [x0, y0, x1, y1] in the 675 x 456 source.

newel_post_lit.note: painted white, but clipped at the film's shoulder: it carries no cast and cannot balance anything

window_curtains.note: white cloth seen through glass, in interior light

concrete_walk.note: concrete is near-neutral but not a calibrated grey

T2769_1965_neutrals.reading: No neutral in the slide calibrates the stone: the white newel is clipped, and the two usable references disagree in sign. Balanced on the curtains the stone leans violet-blue (a* +3.5 to +4.6, b* -5.4 to -7.3); balanced on the concrete walk it leans faintly green-yellow (a* -4.0 to -4.4, b* +2.2 to +3.2). Its chroma is therefore bracketed to within about 9 CIELAB units of grey (8.6 at most on the curtains, 5.4 on the walk), on opposite sides, and the model's neutral grey (after T-2566: linear albedo 0.446, r/g 1.00, b/g 1.00) lies inside the bracket. The tint is ruled not shown by this slide; the neutral grey stands, still reconstructed.
